programme: NFE2L2(NRF2)-driven antioxidant response, cross-talking with HIF1A hypoxia signalling at shared stress-response loci (HMOX1, and via TAF1/CDKN1A/SLC2A1 co-occupancy), while REL (c-Rel/NF-κB) and SP3 form the parallel inflammatory arm that directly interacts with NRF2 target genes (both REL and NFE2L2 target NQO1) and with each other (SP3-NF-κB co-regulation of FGF10/TGFB in airway tissue).
role_in_a: In COPD this axis sets the chronic oxidative-injury/inflammation balance in airway epithelium: NFE2L2 drives the antioxidant program (NQO1, GCLC, HMOX1) that is characteristically insufficient against cigarette-smoke oxidative stress and cellular senescence (PMID 42353844, 42677280), HIF1A adapts tissue to the resulting hypoxia, and REL/SP3 run the accompanying NF-κB inflammatory and remodeling program, including SP3-NF-κB suppression of FGF10 and control of integrin-β8/TGFβ signalling in airway epithelium (PMID 23558680, 20519498) and c-Rel signalling linked to COPD (PMID 40508027).
role_in_b: In endometrioid/gynecologic cancer the same regulators are reported in the opposite direction: NFE2L2/KEAP1 pathway activation is a cytoprotective, immune-evasive programme correlating with tumour mutational burden and PD-L1 (PMID 32272498), acting alongside AKR1C-related NRF2 signalling targeted therapeutically (PMID 41702359) and ERα-NRF2 crosstalk affecting survival (PMID 30597961); HIF1A supports the expected hypoxic/angiogenic tumour phenotype (methylation evidence in gynecologic epithelium, PMID 36510984, though that paper concerns endometriosis rather than endometrioid carcinoma specifically); REL and SP3 contribute to the tumour-promoting inflammatory/stress-hormone transcriptional environment described in ovarian cancer (PMID 18550328, 31362717).
shared_axis: Both tissues experience recurrent oxidative and hypoxic stress — cigarette-smoke injury in airway epithelium, cyclical hypoxia-reperfusion and hormone-driven proliferative stress in endometrial/gynecologic epithelium — and both call on the same NRF2-HIF1A-NF-κB stress circuit; the discordant tagging on NFE2L2/REL/SP3 is consistent with this circuit being engaged in opposite directions (loss of protective antioxidant tone driving COPD damage vs. constitutive activation providing tumour cytoprotection).
reasoning: The module is nameable and NFE2L2/REL/SP3 each have COPD-specific citations plus general-oncology citations, so the pathway is independently documented in both disease contexts; but no retrieved paper connects COPD and endometrioid cancer directly, most cancer citations are ovarian- rather than endometrioid-specific, the one HIF1A gynecologic citation is about endometriosis not endometrioid carcinoma, and no COPD-specific HIF1A paper was retrieved despite its top concordance rank — so the cross-disease link rests on general redox/hypoxia biology rather than a retrieved connecting source.
support: PMID 42353844 - oxidative stress/senescence pathway analysis places NFE2L2 in COPD; PMID 42677280 - network pharmacology places NFE2L2 in COPD; PMID 40508027 - c-Rel (REL) implicated in COPD; PMID 23558680 - SP3-NF-κB interaction reduces FGF10 in airway/COPD context; PMID 20519498 - SP3 regulates TGFβ-activating integrin β8 in airway tissue; PMID 32272498 - NFE2L2/KEAP1 mutation correlates with TMB/PD-L1 in cancer (tagged Endometrioid_Cancer); PMID 41702359 - AKR1C inhibitors with NRF2 relevance show antitumor activity (tagged Endometrioid_Cancer); PMID 30597961 - ERα-NRF2 interaction affects survival in ovarian cancer; PMID 18550328 - beta-adrenergic transcription including REL linked to ovarian cancer; PMID 31362717 - SP3 regulates hCG-beta expression in ovarian cancer; PMID 36510984 - HIF1A promoter methylation reported in endometrial tissue pathogenesis (endometriosis, not confirmed endometrioid carcinoma).
how_to_falsify: Perform ChIP/CUT&RUN for NFE2L2 and HIF1A at the shared HMOX1/NQO1 loci and RNA-seq of NRF2 target genes (NQO1, GCLC, HMOX1) in matched COPD airway epithelium versus endometrioid tumour samples; the account predicts reduced/insufficient NRF2 target activation with impaired HIF1A-HMOX1 co-occupancy in COPD epithelium but constitutively elevated NRF2 target expression with stable KEAP1/NRF2 pathway activation in endometrioid tumour cells. Also test REL/SP3 co-occupancy near NRF2 sites in both tissues — absence of REL-SP3 physical or functional interaction at NQO1/FGF10-region elements in either tissue would undercut the proposed inflammatory arm.
caveats: 156 patient-group comparisons across 4 independent cohort pairs give reasonable replication depth; the tissue pairing (lung vs. uterine endometrium) is anatomically unrelated, so the account must rest on a shared stress-response programme, not lineage. No tissue-generic exclusion list was provided for this pair. The single-view list (IRF6, RORB, VEZF1, HIPK2, TFCP2L1, HR, BATF3, HDAC3, ZFHX3, TCF15, NFX1, PCGF2) plays no role here. KMT2A, ARID4A, NFATC2, IKZF3, RARG, HOXC6, TAF1 and E2F5 passed the concordance filter but have no disease-specific evidence and were deliberately excluded from the carrying module rather than forced into the story. Most cancer-side citations concern ovarian cancer broadly, not endometrioid carcinoma specifically, and the HIF1A gynecologic citation is about endometriosis; treat endometrioid-specificity of the cancer-side evidence as weak.
